summary: Completed backend and frontend testing for photo gallery feature. Backend: 18/19 tests passed (1 skipped due to route conflict). Frontend: All core features working - upload, AI search, tagging, photo display. Minor issue: lightbox click handler blocked by overlay div.

Legacy Photo model in server.py requires 'url' field but new photo_routes uploads don't include it - causes validation error on GET /api/photos
Groq API returning 400 errors (model may need update) - fallback extraction works

ui_bugs.issue: Photo image click doesn't open lightbox - overlay div intercepts pointer events
